GUARANTY OF LEASE

THIS GUARANTY OF LEASE (this "Guaranty") is made as of April 14, 2026 by DEVON ACHEBE, an individual residing at 88 Beech Row, Brooklyn, New York 11217 (the "Guarantor"), in favor of HARBORVIEW RIDGE HOLDINGS LLC, a New York limited liability company (the "Landlord").

RECITALS

The Landlord and LARKSPUR COFFEE COMPANY LLC (the "Tenant") are entering into a lease dated the date hereof (the "Lease") for the ground-floor premises at 88 Sterling Place, Brooklyn, New York (the "Premises"). The Landlord would not enter into the Lease without this Guaranty, and the Guarantor, who owns a majority interest in the Tenant, will benefit from it.

1. GUARANTY — "GOOD GUY" LIMITATION. The Guarantor absolutely and unconditionally guarantees to the Landlord the full and prompt payment of Fixed Rent, Additional Rent, and every other sum the Tenant owes under the Lease, and the performance of every obligation of the Tenant under the Lease, ACCRUING FROM THE COMMENCEMENT DATE THROUGH THE SURRENDER DATE (as defined below), AND NOT THEREAFTER. This is a "good guy" guaranty: the Guarantor's liability ends on the Surrender Date, and the Landlord retains every remedy against the Tenant for obligations accruing after it.

2. SURRENDER DATE. "Surrender Date" means the date on which ALL of the following have occurred: (a) the Tenant has given the Landlord at least ninety (90) days' prior written notice of its intention to vacate; (b) the Tenant has vacated and surrendered the Premises, broom clean and free of all occupants, subtenants, and personal property, and has delivered all keys and access devices to the Landlord; (c) the Tenant has paid all Fixed Rent, Additional Rent, and other sums accrued through the date of surrender; and (d) the Tenant is not then in default under any other provision of the Lease. If any of (a) through (d) has not occurred, the Surrender Date has not occurred and this Guaranty continues.

3. NO RELEASE. The Guarantor's obligations are not affected by, and the Guarantor waives notice of: any amendment, extension, or renewal of the Lease; any assignment or sublease; any indulgence, waiver, or extension of time the Landlord grants the Tenant; the release of any other guarantor; the Tenant's bankruptcy, insolvency, or dissolution; or any defense the Tenant may have other than payment and performance in full.

4. PRIMARY OBLIGATION. This is a guaranty of payment and performance, not of collection. The Landlord may proceed against the Guarantor without first proceeding against the Tenant, exhausting any security, or joining the Tenant in any action.

5. WAIVERS. The Guarantor waives presentment, demand, protest, notice of protest, notice of dishonor, notice of acceptance of this Guaranty, and notice of any default by the Tenant. The Guarantor waives any right of subrogation, reimbursement, contribution, or indemnity against the Tenant until the Landlord has been paid in full.

6. LANDLORD'S FEES. The Guarantor will pay the Landlord's reasonable attorneys' fees and costs incurred in enforcing this Guaranty, and the Landlord will pay the Guarantor's if the Guarantor is the prevailing party, as Real Property Law § 234 makes reciprocal.

7. NEW YORK CITY LOCAL LAW 55. Nothing in this Guaranty is intended to be, and nothing in it shall be construed as, an attempt to enforce a personal-liability provision that Administrative Code § 22-1005 renders unenforceable.

8. NO ORAL MODIFICATION. This Guaranty may not be changed or terminated orally, as General Obligations Law § 15-301 requires.

9. GOVERNING LAW AND VENUE. New York law governs. The Guarantor irrevocably submits to the jurisdiction of the state and federal courts sitting in Kings County, New York, and waives any objection to venue there.

10. JURY WAIVER. THE GUARANTOR AND THE LANDLORD EACH WAIVE TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION ARISING OUT OF THIS GUARANTY OR THE LEASE.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Guarantor has executed this Guaranty as of the date first written above.

/s/ Devon Achebe
DEVON ACHEBE, Guarantor

STATE OF NEW YORK, COUNTY OF KINGS
Acknowledged before me on April 14, 2026 by Devon Achebe.

/s/ Rosalind Achebe Kwan
Notary Public
